ValidationRule.description: Opted out contact cannot be edited.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(opt_out_YRI__c), "opt out"), OR( ISCHANGED(AccountId), ISCHANGED(award_points__c), ISCHANGED(Email), ISCHANGED(FirstName), ISCHANGED(isactive__c), ISCHANGED(LastName), ISCHANGED(User__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opted out contacts cannot be modified.
